verdict.rationale: BILL documents recurring bills, which are templates that generate identical bills for periodic vendor payments (docs-59). That is a first-party recurring, scheduled workflow, but it is narrow and specific to AP bills. Vendor autopay (docs-21) adds automation, though it is triggered by bill creation rather than by a schedule. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, scheduling within Spend & Expense itself (cards, budgets, reimbursements), API-level details for configuring schedule frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
